---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: [enhancement]
---

## The problem

What is hard, slow, confusing, or missing today? Describe the pain in one or two
paragraphs. If your request is "I want X", spell out the underlying problem first — there
may be a simpler answer than X.

## A proposed solution

Sketch what the change would look like from a user's perspective. UI mockups, example
output, or example wizard answers all help.

## Alternatives considered

What did you try first, and why does it not solve the problem?

## Scope

Is this a small tweak or a substantial change? Pointers to the relevant phases, modules,
or files welcome but not required.
